inputs: Synthetic text and an archived synthetic World Labs image; no private input
environment: Mac Chrome; independent cloud browser previously reported WEBGL_UNAVAILABLE

chapters.zh: 回到那儿：可操作的回忆 App；合成示例与本机项目
chapters.en: Back to That Place: an interactive memory App with a synthetic example and local notebooks.

chapters.zh: 三位合成角色的回忆；Agent 整理为明确标注的预设记录
chapters.en: Three fictional contributors. Agent organization is explicitly preset, not live AI.

chapters.zh: 核对来源后，打开提前由 World Labs 真实生成的第一版
chapters.en: After source review, open the first real World Labs output, generated in advance.

chapters.zh: 实际拖动与移动；也可主动切换到已保存的全景
chapters.en: Actual camera movement and exploration, with an archived panorama alternative.

chapters.zh: 补上红色自行车：第二份独立生成结果，旧版仍保留
chapters.en: Add the remembered red bicycle: a second independent generation; the first version remains.

chapters.zh: 新建自己的本机项目：自由文字与带说明的图片
chapters.en: Create a local project with free text and a captioned image. Nothing is uploaded.

chapters.zh: 逐条引用原话；手动修改描述，草稿在刷新后恢复
chapters.en: Source quotations and manual editing; a description draft survives refresh.

chapters.zh: 确认记录已保留；在线 Agent、远程多人和新项目生成尚未开放
chapters.en: Confirmation history is saved. Online AI, remote collaboration and new-world generation are not enabled.

framing: Fixed gray recorder padding below the product was cropped; the continuous timeline was not cut or accelerated.
